method: Facts come from each resource's own website or store listing and, for the exam formats, from the awarding bodies' own specification documents and pages, all read on the checked date. No account was created and nothing was bought, so anything behind a login is reported only as the site describes it. `short` is Winelingo's own wording of those facts, cut to fit a table cell.

official_format.other: Closed-book. One mark per question, no marks subtracted for wrong answers. The specification (Issue 1.2, 2022) says WSET does not release past papers and includes five sample questions with an answer key. Note: the qualification web page on wsetglobal.com shows a '1 hour exam' badge and 'A 1-hour closed-book exam', which differs from the 45 minutes in the specification PDF.

official_format.pass_mark: 55% (Pass 55-69%, Pass with merit 70-84%, Pass with distinction 85% or more)
official_format.other: Closed-book. One mark per question, no marks subtracted for wrong answers. The specification (Issue 2, 2023) says WSET does not release past papers and includes five sample questions with an answer key. Note: the qualification web page on wsetglobal.com shows a '45 min exam' header badge while its text says 'A one-hour closed-book exam comprised of 50 multiple-choice questions'.

official_format.questions: Theory: 50 multiple-choice questions plus four short-written-answer questions of 25 marks each. Tasting: two wines tasted blind.
official_format.pass_mark: 55% in each of the multiple-choice part, the short-written part and the tasting (Pass 55-64%, Pass with merit 65-79%, Pass with distinction 80% and above with no individual paper below 65%)
official_format.other: Closed-book. The specification (Issue 2, 2022) says WSET does not release past papers. It includes five sample multiple-choice questions with an answer key and one sample short-written question (25 marks) without a model answer; it includes no sample tasting question.

official_format.exam: Court of Master Sommeliers Introductory Sommelier Course & Examination (Americas)
official_format.other: The page lists the in-person course and exam at $949 and the online course and exam at $649. It mentions a downloadable workbook for enrolled students and does not mention practice questions or a sample exam. The Court of Master Sommeliers Europe is a separate body: its Introductory page describes 'a multiple-choice theoretical paper plus a short elementary practical service test' with a 60% pass mark for each part, and does not state the number of questions.

resources.name: Winelingo practice tests
resources.what_it_is: Free, unofficial practice tests that run in a browser, for WSET Levels 1 to 3 and the Court of Master Sommeliers Introductory exam.
resources.free_questions: All of it: 10 Level 1 questions, a 50-question Level 2 mock exam, 30 Level 3 multiple-choice questions and 30 Introductory Sommelier questions, each with a timed exam mode and a practice mode that explains every answer. No account.
limits_or_tradeoffs: Each exam has one fixed set of questions, so a second attempt shows the same questions (source: https://winelingo.app/tests/)
Only the Level 2 test is a full-length mock (50 questions); the Level 1 test has 10 questions and the Level 3 and Introductory Sommelier tests have 30 (source: https://winelingo.app/tests/)
The Level 3 test is multiple choice only; it does not cover the short-written answers or the tasting (source: https://winelingo.app/tests/wset-level-3-practice/)

short.what: Ours: free browser tests, one fixed set per exam
short.free: All 120 questions, incl. a 50-question Level 2 mock, no sign-up

resources.name: WSET specification PDFs (Level 1, 2 and 3 Award in Wines)
resources.what_it_is: The official syllabus documents, each with an exam-format section and a short set of sample examination questions.
resources.free_questions: Five sample multiple-choice questions with an answer key in each of the Level 1, Level 2 and Level 3 specifications; Level 3 also has one sample short-written question (25 marks, no model answer). Free PDF download, no account.
resources.question_count: 5 per level (plus 1 written question at Level 3)
limits_or_tradeoffs: Each specification states that WSET does not release past papers, so the five sample questions are the only official ones published there (source: https://www.wsetglobal.com/media/3yuhxb4i/wset-l2wines-specification.pdf)
Answers are given as a letter key only, with no explanations (source: https://www.wsetglobal.com/media/zyhewzz4/wset-l1wines-specification.pdf)
The Level 3 sample short-written question has no model answer, and there is no sample tasting question (source: https://www.wsetglobal.com/media/ugpjmqol/wset-l3wines-specification.pdf)
unverified: Whether WSET course providers hand out further official practice material to enrolled students (not stated on the pages fetched)

short.what: Official syllabus PDFs with five sample questions per level
short.free: 5 sample questions per level, answer key, no account

resources.name: Sommo
resources.maker: Sommo ("An independent wine app, made in London"; footer credits Gökhan Arkan)
resources.what_it_is: A wine app with free browser-based mock tests, flashcards and cheat sheets for WSET levels and the Court of Master Sommeliers exams.
resources.free_questions: On the web, free and without sign-up, with unlimited retakes: WSET Level 1 mock (50 questions drawn from a 180-question bank), WSET Level 2 mock (50 multiple-choice questions), WSET Level 3 mock (50 multiple-choice questions), CMS Introductory practice exam (70 questions drawn from a bank of 162).
resources.question_count: Level 1 bank: 180; CMS Introductory bank: 162; Level 2 and Level 3 bank sizes not stated
resources.price: Web study tools: free. App: Basic is free and includes WSET Level 1 prep; Premium is "$4.99 a month or $29.99 a year in the US" and is needed for WSET Levels 2 to 4 in the app.
limits_or_tradeoffs: The mock pages state "This independent quiz is not an official paper or a complete exam simulation" (source: https://sommo.app/wset/level-2/mock-test/)
The Level 3 mock is multiple choice only; its questions "do not reproduce the written-answer or tasting assessments" (source: https://sommo.app/wset/level-3/mock-test/)
In the app, WSET Levels 2 to 4 are Premium only; prices vary by country and store (source: https://sommo.app/pricing/)
unverified: Whether the web mock tests run against a timer (the pages fetched do not say)
Contents of the Level 4 (D3) mock test and the CMS Certified tools (linked, not fetched in detail)

resources.name: WineRevision
resources.maker: WineRevision.com (operator not named on the site)
resources.what_it_is: A free study site with flashcards, mock examinations and a 60-second timed challenge for WSET Level 2 and Level 3 wines.
resources.free_questions: Without an account: sample flashcards and a 10-question Level 2 sample test. With a free account: Level 2 "450+ flashcards" and 6 mock exams (300 questions); Level 3 over 1,150 flashcards and 10 mock exams (500 questions). The site says "100% free · No credit card required".

Who operates the site

resources.name: Wine Exam Trainer
resources.what_it_is: A subscription question bank with timed mock exams for WSET Level 2, Level 3 and the Diploma, including AI-marked open questions.
resources.free_questions: Without an account: 25 Level 2 sample questions (one per chapter) with explanations, the first chapters, one timed mock exam per level (Level 2: 50 randomly drawn questions, 60-minute timer), and one AI-marked open question per day.
resources.question_count: 3,516 in total as stated (Level 2: 968 multiple-choice; Level 3: 1,576 multiple-choice and 612 open; Diploma: 360 open)
resources.price: €9 per month, or €30 per 6 months (one plan covers the levels; the Level 2 page says full access "includes Level 3")

No WSET Level 1 or Court of Master Sommeliers material is listed (source: https://wineexamtrainer.com)
Open-question answers are marked by AI against key facts, not by a human examiner, and the subscription renews automatically until cancelled (source: https://wineexamtrainer.com)
unverified: The time limit used for the Level 3 mock (the page says only that it is timed)

short.free: 25 questions and one timed mock per level, no account

resources.name: Eclavin
resources.what_it_is: A study site and iOS app with multiple-choice practice questions and worked explanations for WSET Levels 1 to 3.
resources.free_questions: On the web: "All 100 Level 2 questions on Eclavin are free" and "All 100 Level 1 questions on Eclavin are free", each with a worked explanation; "there is no sign-up".
resources.question_count: 100 per level on the web (Levels 1 and 2); the site describes the app as having "2,000+ questions across Levels 1, 2 and 3"

What is free inside the app without the Level 2 and Level 3 unlocks

resources.name: ThirtyFifty mock exams and practice questions
resources.maker: ThirtyFifty (a WSET course provider in London)
resources.what_it_is: Mock exams and chapter questions written by a WSET course provider, free to its own students and sold to everyone else.
resources.free_questions: With a free account: Level 1, two mock exams of 30 questions each; Level 2, a 15-question trial exam; Level 3, the viticulture chapter questions (25 multiple-choice and two written). All resources are free to ThirtyFifty's own students.
resources.question_count: Level 1: 60. Level 2: 250 (5 mock exams of 50) plus a 15-question trial. Level 3: 10 multiple-choice mock exams of 50 questions and 4 short-written exams of four questions, plus chapter questions.
resources.price: Level 1: free. Level 2 mock exams: £15 for 12 months' access. Level 3: mock exams £30, chapter questions £20, flash cards £25, wine maps £20, tasting exam flash cards £10.
limits_or_tradeoffs: Sign-in is required even for the free questions: "To access questions please sign in or Register Here" (source: https://thirtyfifty.co.uk/WSET-L2-Wine-Exam-Questions.asp)

The Level 2 page says the questions follow "the current 2026" syllabus and also that "One purchase gives you access to both the 2023 and 2019 syllabus", so the buyer has to pick the right set (source: https://thirtyfifty.co.uk/WSET-L2-Wine-Exam-Questions.asp)

Level 3 is sold as separate products, and the pages do not describe a timer or per-question explanations beyond answers and marking schedules (source: https://thirtyfifty.co.uk/WSET-L3-Exam-Questions.asp)
unverified: Whether the mock exams are timed and whether answers include explanations (not stated on the pages; not checked inside an account)

resources.name: portnwine WSET practice
resources.maker: portnwine (a blog about Portuguese wine; operator not named on the site)
resources.what_it_is: Free timed mock papers for WSET Levels 1, 2 and 3, each a random draw from the site's question bank.

The site does not name who writes the questions; the About page describes a blog about wine from Portugal (source: https://portnwine.com/about-1)

Question bank size and author
